title: A Living Dog Sculpture That Holds a Lantern! 🤯🐶 #DIY #Topiary
description:
A broken porch lantern inspires one of the coolest garden transformations! 🐶🌿

After a playful golden retriever puppy accidentally knocks over a standing lantern, the couple decides to turn the broken fixture into the inspiration for a completely new outdoor decoration.

They build a life-sized dog-shaped wire frame and place a plant inside the base. With regular watering and time, lush green foliage grows through the mesh, gradually forming the shape of a realistic dog.

Once the plant is fully grown, the couple carefully trims the excess leaves and removes the wire frame to reveal the finished living dog topiary. A new lantern is then placed in the dog's mouth, creating a unique glowing decoration for the front porch.

🌿 Build Highlights:

• Recovering from a broken porch lantern
• Building a life-sized dog-shaped wire frame
• Planting greenery inside the frame
• Growing foliage through the mesh
• Training the plants into a dog shape
• Carefully trimming the finished topiary
• Removing the wire frame
• Revealing the living dog sculpture
• Installing a glowing lantern
• Creating a unique front porch decoration
